featured_reviews.name: Prema Rau
featured_reviews.review_text: TMSI has been a wonderful experience for our son since he joined in August 2024. The school managed his transition beautifully, making him feel at ease even after our relocation. The Montessori guides are incredibly loving and attentive, consistently bringing out the best in him. We've seen great improvement in his manners, behavior, and overall confidence. What stands out most is the strong, inclusive culture that extends beyond the classroom and even beyond TMSI families. It truly feels like a supportive community. We’re very grateful for the nurturing environment TMSI provides—it's been the perfect start to his educational journey.

featured_reviews.name: shehzeen cassum
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just a few months in and it's been a period that has made our child blossom and her expressive vocabulary explode.

A wonderful learning environment with real learning and real world skills that moves at the pace of the child through observation and careful adaptive learning. EPL (Exercises of practical life) is high, something immensely important for all children (and adults alike :), we see direct evidence of it at home, in methodical thinking, execution. Lots of small invaluable life skills learnt at a young age without bribes/rewards is slowly steadily encouraged, taught and modelled. Wonderful spatial layout, no overload of toys, mostly wooden and cloth Montessori activities made from safe child friendly materials. The indoor spaces bleed into an beautiful open outdoor verandah terrace space that I personally would love to be in too while doing art!

Connecting with plants, nature, fine art, music is very encouraged at TMSI. I HAVE TO SAY GREAT PARENTS ALL AROUND. Every single child & family we have interacted with is really nice. The kids are all great, a very global classroom - a mix of Indian kids with kids from all over the world. Very inclusive classroom environment even with foreign language barriers.
The interview/admission process was very easy simple and smooth flowing. As parents you are very much kept abreast with the day to day activities. The solemnity of the space + activity/work a child does is greatly respected and gradually built on as and when the child is ready. Transitioning between toddler and primary years is well handled.
I love the attention each child receives, potty training is dealt with too. Small classes and teacher to student ratio is great.

The staff has a fantastic vibe, very loving, welcoming, warm, empathic and just overall a cut well above the rest (without a shadow of a doubt). Special mention to Ms.Neha and Ms.Moonira who have made transitioning from home to the montessori environment seamless. Any incidents at school are dealt with the utmost professionalism and compassion.
If you are looking for a pure Monstessori school, with really dedicated teachers who practice what they preach- this is one of the best. The drive and commitment the teachers have is really unmatched. Very relaxed, calm vibes inside the classrooms, great for learning, each child is working on different things- education is child led, observation of the children is parent inclusive once each term, although it is so therapeutic and zen, I could watch them all day. Also, a very warm comfortable experience for new parents too. All ex-students and their parents have the nicest things to say about TMSI as well unanimously.
Even when a child is late for drop off there is no awkwardness from the staff. They factor all aspects of the settling process for a new child.

Digital sharing of photos and updates via Transparent classrooms for parents allows everyone to remain connected to everything a child is introduced to, practices and eventually masters.

Lovely outdoor excursions to embrace nature. Excellent weekly themes and  a wide range of Montessori activities in the toddler and primary classrooms.
I really appreciate joint meals and joint meals preparation by the kids for the kids. I think all that is planned is so mindful, really engaging and shows phenomenal long term results.

Lots of expat crowd. My friend's child who attended TMSI left to go back to their country. A very nice set of farewell notes were shared with the family. Lots of attention to details, it's really personal and non commercial which is just refreshing too see these days.

Waiting for them to expand to the Elementary classroom for older students, post 6 years!

Thank you TMSI for an excellent experience so far!

featured_reviews.name: Karan Garg
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughters have studied at TMSI for 3 years and we are super happy with their development and progress. The Montessori approach is great for early development of children and the TMSI teachers are regarded among the parent community for the care and sensitive handling of students.

featured_reviews.name: Carl Engh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our daughter started at TMSI when she was just 2 years old, and it has been such a wonderful journey for her and for us as parents. From day one, we felt the school was a safe, nurturing, and inspiring environment where she could grow at her own pace.

The teachers and staff are caring, transparent, and genuinely invested in each child’s development. They helped her with everything from learning independence in daily routines to bigger milestones like potty training, always with patience and encouragement. The Montessori approach at TMSI has given her confidence, curiosity, and a love of learning that we know will stay with her.

We are only leaving because we’re moving back to our country. Otherwise, we would have happily kept her at TMSI until she turned six. We’re so grateful for the foundation TMSI has given her and can’t recommend the school highly enough to other parents.

featured_reviews.name: Saranya Kapur
featured_reviews.review_text: My child has been attending TMSI for 2 months now and has been enjoying it.  The facility is tranquil and airy, and there is an outdoor space for the kids to play. The teachers are loving and able to build a rapport with the kids easily. We also like the Montessori method as it builds independence, creativity and executive function, and allows the children to socialize with others of varying age groups.  The settling in period allows kids to slowly and gently acclimate to the school setting.  Overall, our family is happy with the school and highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Anand Chadha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Love TMSI! So happy to have made the decision to send my children here. They follow a true Montessori approach, the teachers are excellent, and more importantly they have a very small batch of children so each child is given individual attention.

Highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Krutika Maniar
featured_reviews.review_text: We love this school and highly recommend. They follow schooling and Montessori in its truest spirit without any major frills. The class room and environment is unlike other Montessori schools we’ve noticed around - calm, well lit and ventilated, and offers good space for toddlers to move around. Especially the outdoor terrace is a big win for a city like Bombay and a major attraction for the kids. The teachers are very warm, caring, and supportive, even with parents! We are very happy with our son’s progress and overall development aided by this school and it’s teachers.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Naik
featured_reviews.review_text: Our son has been going there for the past 1 year and he has been loving it. The teachers are very very friendly and have ensured that our shy son has blossomed into a friendly child. They also ensure that the child is not pushed into a rat race and grows at his own speed. I would definitely recommend TMSI to all parents who would want their kids and I spend time in a happy safe and educational environment that allows kids the independence to grow at their own pace.

featured_reviews.name: Farheen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a proud parent of Rose Manor International School 🤍

“Choosing RMIS was one of our best decisions.”

Rose Manor has made a remarkable difference in my child Ashar’s confidence, learning, and overall growth. I’ve seen consistent improvement in academics, with excellent performance in exams, along with a beautiful development in personality and self-confidence.
I can truly see each child achieving their fullest potential with the superb efforts of the management and teachers. The teachers are incredibly warm, attentive, and supportive, always nurturing each child and bringing out their best version. The environment feels safe, encouraging, and truly like a second home. As parents, it gives us great peace of mind and happiness to see our child thriving.
We’re genuinely grateful to have chosen RMIS 🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: jashinta dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
As parents, we feel truly grateful to be part of Rose manor International School. Both of our children have had an amazing experience here, and we have seen tremendous growth in their confidence, knowledge, and overall personality.

Rose Manor International school provides a perfect balance of academics and extracurricular activities, ensuring that children not only learn but also enjoy the process. The teachers are caring, supportive, and highly dedicated—they give individual attention to each child and make learning fun and engaging.

We especially appreciate the safe and positive environment the school maintains. My children feel happy, secure, and excited to go to school every day, which means a lot to us as parents.

The school’s focus on values, discipline, and creativity is truly commendable. We have seen our children become more responsible, expressive, and enthusiastic learners.

Thank you to all the teachers and staff for your constant efforts and dedication. We highly recommend this school to every parent looking for the best for their children.

featured_reviews.name: Kezia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I spent several valuable years at Rose Manor and it remains a place I will remember fondly. The teachers and staff always supported us and had our best interests at heart, they guided and disciplined us with love.

Alongside the Cambridge syllabus, Rose Manor equally focuses on development beyond academics, giving us students the freedom to enjoy childhood with extracurricular activities and events such as : the annual and sports day, where we are given the opportunity to showcase our talents and learn about ourselves as individuals.

I always took great pleasure in participating in the annual days and found them to be a wonderful platform to express myself in different creative ways, with dance always being my favourite.

Ma’am Mary Rose Nazareth was the foundation of Rose Manor and made our school a nurturing, warm, safe place for everyone. The school continues to carry fragments of ma’am through the values she instilled in all of us, truly making it a special place. ❤️

I’ll always be grateful for the years spent at Rose Manor and would definitely recommend it as a perfect school to help your child grow and shape their own identity.

featured_reviews.name: Farida Vohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
RMIS school is a great place for learning and personal growth. The teachers are supportive and explain concepts clearly, making even difficult subjects easier to understand. The school provides good facilities such as canteens and sports grounds.
One of the best things about the  school is the focus on both academics and extracurricular activities. Students are encouraged to participate in sports, cultural events, and competitions, which helps build confidence and teamwork.
The environment is friendly and disciplined, and the staff ensures that students feel safe and motivated. Overall,  school plays an important role in shaping my child future, and I feel proud to be a part of it.

featured_reviews.name: Yohan Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been a student of Rose Manor International School, and those were some of the most cherished and joyful days of my life. The teachers were incredibly dedicated and caring, the field trips were meaningful and educational, and every corner of the school holds beautiful memories. Mary Rose Ma’am was a true visionary, with a heart that genuinely cared for every child.
This school will always remain close to my heart. I truly believe that anyone who joins Rose Manor will one day have their own wonderful memories and testimony to share. Cheers to a school I will always love.

featured_reviews.name: Ansh Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rose Manor School is a great place for students to learn, grow, and build confidence. The school provides a positive and friendly environment where students feel comfortable and motivated every day.

The teachers are supportive, understanding, and always ready to help. They focus not only on academics but also on overall development, encouraging students to participate in activities, competitions, and teamwork. Their way of teaching makes concepts easier to understand and more interesting.

The school also offers a good balance between studies and extracurricular activities, which helps students explore their talents in sports, arts, and other fields. The discipline and values taught here help shape students into responsible individuals.

Overall, Rose Manor School is a wonderful institution that focuses on both education and personal growth. It is a place where students create memories, build friendships, and prepare for a bright future.

ansh gupta

featured_reviews.name: saif khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m really happy with Rosemanor International School. My children have improved a lot since joining the school, not just in studies but also in confidence and overall personality.

The teachers are very supportive and friendly, and they give proper attention to each child. Because of their guidance, my children are performing very well in academics and enjoying learning.

I would definitely recommend this school to other parents.

featured_reviews.name: Path agrawal (Silent Killer)
featured_reviews.review_text: Rose Manor International School offers a friendly and caring environment where children feel comfortable and enjoy going to school. The school focuses not only on academics but also on overall development through activities like arts, music, and personality building. With small class sizes, students receive more personal attention from teachers, which supports better learning. It also provides modern classrooms and safe transport facilities with GPS tracking, making it a reliable and well-rounded choice, especially for early education.
